title: NEXY Proposal Forge
summary: A deterministic, fail-closed sandbox that evaluates AI-proposed NEXY feature candidates without granting them requirement or implementation authority.
problem: Parallel AI sessions can generate plausible feature ideas that are duplicated, weakly evidenced, authority-conflicting, or accidentally presented as current NEXY truth.
intended_users: AI agents producing future feature proposals
user_outcomes: See whether a proposal is distinct from an existing candidate catalog
See explicit evidence and authority gaps before considering implementation
Keep AI creativity isolated from canonical NEXY requirements
non_goals: Promote a proposal into DOC-B, DOC-C, DOC-D, or DOC-E
Use model confidence as implementation evidence
risks: Similarity heuristics can miss semantic duplicates that use very different wording
Evidence references can become stale and therefore require human/project review

evidence.claim: AI-CONTEXT requires design, repository truth, runtime truth, assumptions, and unknowns to remain distinct.
Indexed duplicate/overlap search performed before this proposal found no existing AI-CONTEXT feature-proposal admission implementation matching this concept.
